changelog: Initial release: Full Facticity.AI integration enabling claim fact-checking, claim extraction, URL transcription, and source reliability scoring. Built from award-winning research (TIME Best Invention 2024), designed for high-stakes verification across text, audio, and video. Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, X Spaces, and other multimedia URLs.
